designs.name: Nova
designs.spec: Compact lavender and ivory floating companion robot inspired by the warmth of Weebo from Flubber, with a friendly rounded rectangular expressive face displaying TWO violet eyes, smooth small oval body, two small mitten-like manipulator hands; subtle violet research scanner on its chest. No huge single camera eye, wing blades, rings, spikes, or legs. Working: holds and scans a small open reference book with its hands.
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent directional sprite sheet for an illustrated robot office.
Primary request: Redesign ONLY the specified robot, using the input image for illustration style, material shading and outline quality. Create one sheet of this SAME new robot in exactly 20 separate full-body poses.
Style: match reference's warmly shaded hand-painted pixel illustration, cream mechanical shells, dark outlines, clearly readable at small size. Original robot design.
LAYOUT: EXACTLY 5 equal columns by 4 equal rows, canvas 1280 wide x 1024 high, transparent RGBA background. Each cell is 256x256. Each robot fully inside its own cell with 25px clear gutters, same body size, no overlaps. NO text, labels, grid lines, floor or shadows.
Rows are camera views: row 1 FRONT facing viewer (south); row 2 LEFT PROFILE facing LEFT (west); row 3 RIGHT PROFILE facing RIGHT (east); row 4 BACK facing away (north). Show all four views.
Columns are action: column 1 neutral standing, empty hands/tools stowed; column 2 walking left-leg forward, tools stowed; column 3 walking right-leg forward, tools stowed; column 4 WORK gesture A with role-specific tool; column 5 WORK gesture B with same tool, visibly changed hand/tool position.
Maintain identical head, body, accent colors and proportions in all cells. Grounded robots have feet at the same baseline in each cell. For hover robots show the same hover altitude, two travel phases with slightly different hand tilt, no shadows.
Subject: Nova. Compact lavender and ivory floating companion robot inspired by the warmth of Weebo from Flubber, with a friendly rounded rectangular expressive face displaying TWO violet eyes, smooth small oval body, two small mitten-like manipulator hands; subtle violet research scanner on its chest. No huge single camera eye, wing blades, rings, spikes, or legs. Working: holds and scans a small open reference book with its hands.

designs.name: Apollo
designs.spec: Agile upright humanoid engineering robot inspired by Boston Dynamics Atlas and sleek Tesla/Xpeng humanoid robots. Exactly two arms and two athletic articulated legs, generous rounded cream armor, charcoal joints, violet accent panels, friendly black visor with TWO violet eyes. Small folded tool pack on back. Working: holds a small violet diagnostic tablet in left hand and taps it with right hand. No extra limbs or spider/insect body.
